verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party webhooks documentation says integrators can subscribe to real-time events, so the product itself provides event subscription. The evidence is a single thin mention, and the 'journal API' wording (retrieving historical event data and snapshots) leaves unclear whether delivery is via registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or retrieval. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of registering a target URL for outbound HTTP callbacks, the supported event types, delivery/retry and signature-verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: the webhooks journal API enables third-party integrators to subscribe to real-time events, retrieve historical event data, and manage snapshots of CRM objects
